title: Hewlett Packard Enterprise Reports $14.5 Billion Q4 Revenue
summary: Hewlett Packard Enterprise reported fiscal Q4 2026 revenue of $14.5 billion, up 50%, and non-GAAP EPS of $1.43, and raised its fiscal 2027 outlook.
body_markdown:
Cloud & AI revenue was $11.3 billion, up 68.6% from the prior-year period, including Server revenue of $8.8 billion, up 94.7%. Networking revenue was $3.1 billion, up 12.3% from the prior-year period.


For the first quarter of fiscal 2027, HPE estimates revenue in the range of $14.0 billion to $14.6 billion and non-GAAP diluted EPS of $1.30 to $1.40. For the full fiscal 2027, the company said it is raising its revenue growth outlook range to 27% to 35%, representing $59.4 billion to $63.1 billion, raising its non-GAAP diluted EPS estimate to $5.05 to $5.35, and now expects free cash flow of at least $5.5 billion.


## Why It Matters for HPE


CEO Antonio Neri said in the release that “Fiscal 2026 was a defining year for HPE as we built a new networking industry leader and expanded our role in the AI infrastructure market.” CFO Marie Myers said the company reached its results while “navigating a highly dynamic market and successfully integrating the largest acquisition in HPE’s history,” and enters fiscal 2027 “with a significantly higher outlook for revenue, operating profit, and free cash flow.”
